title: Ultraverse Firearm Vol 1 #16 Malibu Comics January 1995
descriptionText: The Ultraverse Firearm Volume 1 Issue #16 from Malibu Comics, January 1995, is a sought-after comic book in the US Comics tradition. The issue features content from the popular Ultraverse series, known for its action-packed storylines and dynamic characters. As a collector's item, this comic book captures a moment in the history of graphic novels and is a must-have for fans of the genre.
